build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a dynamic ball and static bars in a scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale, center_x, and bottom position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_goal: update the task goal to require the ball touching a target floor using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the solution metadata tier to BALL using C.set_meta and C.SolutionTier.BALL
